name: Snake
author: Tomas Tulka
description: The classic Snake: eat the fruit to grow longer and don't bite your own tail or hit the walls.

descriptions.en: The classic Snake: eat the fruit to grow longer and don't bite your own tail or hit the walls.
descriptions.it: Il classico Snake: mangia la frutta per allungarti e non morderti la coda né sbattere contro i muri.
